title: WAL callback frame consumption

scope.rationale: sqlite3WalCallback consumes and clears the frame count recorded by the most recent commit, while sqlite3PagerWalCallback forwards that one-shot observation through the Pager owner.

external_source_responsibilities: Successful commit publication and connection hook dispatch
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete consume-and-clear functions are assigned; runtime WAL append publishes the committed terminal frame and connection post-commit dispatch consumes it through Pager.

inputs: Nullable mutable Wal or mutable Pager with optional owned Wal
outputs: Pending callback frame number or zero
contracts.ownership: Mutates only the pending scalar callback value.
contracts.state_and_results: Null or missing WAL returns zero. Non-null returns callback_frame exactly and clears it to zero, so repeated reads return zero until another successful commit.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Does not invoke the hook or perform I/O; caller synchronization external.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No failure path; consumption is one-shot.

representation_differences: The bounded Wal field is named callback_frame instead of iCallback; the result remains u32 until the eventual C API boundary.
The runtime Pager owns optional wal.Wal directly and performs the same nullable consume-and-clear operation rather than calling across a C module boundary.

oracle.protocol: Observe zero with no Pager WAL; publish a successful one-frame WAL commit, observe 1 through Pager, then observe zero on repeat; the internal source-state owner separately covers null, seeded 17, and repeated zero.
oracle.normalization: Frame count and zero sentinel are exact.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Successful WAL append publishes callback_frame only after the committed index publication; failed append paths leave it unchanged. Pager consumption performs no I/O; caller synchronization is external.
assurance.continuation: Repeated consumption remains zero until a later commit publishes a frame.

integration.production_owner: src/core/wal.zig runtime Wal plus src/core/pager.zig Pager, with src/core/internal/wal_core.zig source-state owner
integration.native_call_path: Successful runtime WAL append records callback_frame, Pager.takeWalCallbackFrame consumes it once, and the post-commit connection callback path invokes the configured hook only for a positive result.

independent_review.notes: Requires connection hook integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

Verify every failed commit publication boundary against pinned C.
